shadows.name: subtle

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-emphasis action with a clear blue surface and restrained state feedback.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: var(--wpx-color-primary); color: var(--wpx-color-on-primary); padding: 0 24px; min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--wpx-radius-sm); font: 500 16px/1.25 var(--wpx-font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--wpx-duration-fast) var(--wpx-ease-out); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--wpx-color-primary-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--wpx-focus-ring); } .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--wpx-color-primary-hover); }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Low-emphasis navigation or secondary action; remains subordinate to the primary control.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--wpx-color-primary); font: 500 14px/20px var(--wpx-font-sans); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: color var(--wpx-duration-fast) var(--wpx-ease-out); } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--wpx-color-primary-hover); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: none; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: var(--wpx-focus-ring); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Quiet content grouping defined by a thin border rather than default elevation.
components.html:
Card title

Supporting content sits on a quiet, clearly bounded surface.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--wpx-color-card); color: var(--wpx-color-card-foreground); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--wpx-color-border); border-radius: var(--wpx-radius-md); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 20px/28px var(--wpx-font-sans); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--wpx-color-muted-foreground); font: 400 16px/26px var(--wpx-font-sans); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled, legible field with a visible keyboard focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--wpx-color-foreground); font: 500 14px/20px var(--wpx-font-sans); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--wpx-color-border); border-radius: var(--wpx-radius-sm); background: var(--wpx-color-background); color: var(--wpx-color-foreground); font: 400 16px/24px var(--wpx-font-sans); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--wpx-color-muted-foreground); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--wpx-color-primary); box-shadow: var(--wpx-focus-ring); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Simple text navigation with clear focus and understated blue interaction feedback.

components.description: Compact neutral label with a restrained pill shape, not a primary action.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--wpx-color-border); border-radius: var(--wpx-radius-full); background: var(--wpx-color-muted); color: var(--wpx-color-muted-foreground); font: 500 12px/16px var(--wpx-font-sans); }

narrative.overview:
WorkPlanX’s visual language is calm and precise: it makes complex project and field operations feel understandable without making the product feel decorative or lightweight. Clear hierarchy, generous space, practical product evidence, and direct language support a trustworthy, operationally focused character.

The system is restrained and clear. Blue is reserved for brand emphasis and actionable focus; cool slate neutrals carry most content and surfaces. Surfaces are flat by default, with borders doing the everyday work of separation and subtle shadows used only where genuine lift helps. The existing implementation has tokens and global styles but no built page sections or component library; component entries above are reference primitives synthesized from the documented token rules, not claims about implemented UI.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained blue against cool, legible neutrals
Flat by default; practical rather than decorative

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep the official blue the single dominant brand accent; do not introduce an unrelated CTA accent.

rules.name: The Inter-Throughout Rule
rules.body: Use the same sans-serif family across display, headings, body, and controls; do not introduce a contrasting display face without approved brand guidance.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer a quiet border over a shadow for ordinary surface separation; avoid heavy shadows and glass-like blurred layers.

dos: Do use official logo artwork from `docs/brand/` without recoloring or distortion.
Do use the CSS custom properties in `src/styles/tokens.css` as the token source of truth.
Do keep text contrast, labels, and keyboard focus clear.
Do prefer authentic product evidence over decorative imagery when product visuals are eventually introduced.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences for any future motion.
donts: Don't introduce a second, unrelated accent color for primary actions.
Don't add glassmorphism, heavy shadows, excessive motion, or layout-shifting hover effects.
Don't use emoji as interface icons; use a consistent SVG icon family.
Don't suppress visible focus or communicate status by color alone.
Don't fabricate product screens, customer proof, or unsupported claims.
